highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update.
highlights_body: The bundled renderer includes current upstream fixes. Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should verify text output after upgrading.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the latest upstream fixes. On Linux, font fallback now tries FcFontMatch before FcFontSort, which can select a different fallback face; specify a family and style or bundle a typeface when exact metrics and glyphs matter.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: The preview includes current upstream engine fixes. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback should verify text output, as a different fallback face may be selected.
